name: io.github.jeffsosville/dealledger
title: DealLedger
description: US businesses for sale, observed on broker sites: listings, observed age, price changes.

tools.name: get_listing_history
tools.description: Everything DealLedger has observed about one business-for-sale listing: current asking price and cash flow, observed listing age with its evidence and confidence, reviewed asking-price changes with dates, relist signal, whether it is still listed, the broker’s original page and the permanent DealLedger URL.

listing.description: DealLedger listing number or a dealledger.org/listing/… URL

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search US businesses for sale in DealLedger’s public record (observed on brokers’ own websites). Each result gives price, cash flow, observed listing age with evidence, relist signal, broker and the permanent DealLedger URL. total is the full number of matches; page with offset. Business types: restaurant, retail, healthcare, technology, automotive, construction, manufacturing, delivery_route, cleaning, amusement, hvac, landscaping, laundromat, plumbing, electrical, roofing, dry_cleaner, vending, pool_service, junk_removal, pest_control, atm, pressure_washing, car_wash, salon_spa, gas_station, childcare, pet, liquor_store, accounting, fitness, sign_print, trucking.

state.description: US state, as a code ("TX") or name ("Texas")

q.description: Words in the listing title, e.g. "car wash"

min_cash_flow.description: Minimum reported cash flow in USD

min_age_days.description: Only listings observed on the market at least this many days

offset.description: Skip this many results; use next_offset from the previous answer to page

tools.name: search_price_changes
tools.description: Search reviewed asking-price changes on US businesses for sale (cuts and increases observed on brokers’ own listing pages). Each result gives the old and new price, the date window in which the change happened, the listing and its permanent DealLedger URL. total is the full number of matches; page with offset. Business types: restaurant, retail, healthcare, technology, automotive, construction, manufacturing, delivery_route, cleaning, amusement, hvac, landscaping, laundromat, plumbing, electrical, roofing, dry_cleaner, vending, pool_service, junk_removal, pest_control, atm, pressure_washing, car_wash, salon_spa, gas_station, childcare, pet, liquor_store, accounting, fitness, sign_print, trucking.

state.description: US state, as a code ("FL") or name ("Florida")

min_pct.description: Minimum size of the change in percent, e.g. 10

since.description: Only changes observed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

offset.description: Skip this many results; use next_offset from the previous answer to page

tools.name: check_relisting
tools.description: Check whether a business-for-sale listing shows evidence of having been listed before under a different listing. Returns the signal, its confidence and how it was derived. A possible relist is never confirmed proof.

listing.description: DealLedger listing number or a dealledger.org/listing/… URL
